premise: The light turns copper-red, the solar panel's power dips and Leo worries for his flower's lamp — until he understands: the Earth is passing in front of the Sun, ringed with every sunrise and sunset at once.
inspiration: 'Henny Penny' (folk tale), where a hen runs off crying that the sky is falling, turned: this time someone stops to look before running.
lesson: Look first; the strange thing might be a wonder.
learning: During an eclipse seen from the Moon, the Earth hides the Sun and the light turns red from all the sunrises and sunsets around the Earth.

en-US.title: The Red Light
en-US.text: {man:enter} Leo was checking on his {flower:enter} flower when the light began to change. {canvas:eclipse} Slowly, the bright white sunshine turned a deep, glowing copper-red. {man:face surprised} Out on the plain, the {solar-panel:enter} solar panel {solar-panel:live} tilted and tilted, searching for the Sun. {man:live} {sfx:beep} Leo checked his wrist. The panel's power was dropping! {man:face sad} {man:says} [nervously] “If the power runs low, the flower's lamp goes out!” {flower:shake 0.3} Then he understood. [gasps] {man:face surprised} The Earth was passing right in front of the Sun. And all around the Earth's edge shone a thin ring of red-gold light: every sunset and every new morning on Earth, all at once. {man:says} [in awe] “It's an eclipse.” {man:pulse} [softly] {man:face happy} He sat down to watch. The panel waited. {flower:glow 0.4} The flower waited. At last, the white light came back. {solar-panel:sparkle} {man:hearts} {man:says} [warmly] “Lamp's still on. And you saw an eclipse.”

es-ES.title: La luz roja
es-ES.text: {man:enter} Leo estaba cuidando su {flower:enter} flor cuando la luz empezó a cambiar. {canvas:eclipse} Poco a poco, el sol blanco y brillante se volvió de un rojo cobrizo, intenso y cálido. {man:face surprised} En la llanura, el {solar-panel:enter} panel solar {solar-panel:live} se inclinó y se inclinó, buscando el Sol. {man:live} {sfx:beep} Leo miró su muñeca. ¡La energía del panel estaba bajando! {man:face sad} {man:says} [nervously] «¡Si baja la energía, se apaga la lámpara de la flor!» {flower:shake 0.3} Entonces lo entendió. [gasps] {man:face surprised} La Tierra estaba pasando justo por delante del Sol. Y alrededor de su borde brillaba un fino anillo de luz rojiza y dorada: todos los amaneceres y atardeceres de la Tierra, a la vez. {man:says} [in awe] «Es un eclipse.» {man:pulse} [softly] {man:face happy} Se sentó a mirar. El panel esperó. {flower:glow 0.4} La flor esperó. Por fin, volvió la luz blanca. {solar-panel:sparkle} {man:hearts} {man:says} [warmly] «La lámpara sigue encendida. Y has visto un eclipse.»
